en.description:
Momo: Watch Games is a pack of quick games built for your Apple Watch. Each round takes seconds, so you can play while you wait for coffee, the bus, or a meeting to start. No ads.

PUZZLE, REFLEX AND HEAD TO HEAD
Slide and merge tiles, flip lights, flood a grid with color, and solve Sudoku. Keep a ball inside a ring, stack a wobbly tower, crack the lock, or take on the computer in air hockey, Drop Four, Flip and more. Every game is simple to learn and hard to put down.

BUILT FOR A SMALL SCREEN
Tap, swipe or drag, and turn the Digital Crown if you like. The games are designed for your wrist first, not squeezed down from something bigger.

LEVEL UP AS YOU PLAY
Every round earns XP. Build a daily streak, collect bronze to diamond medals in each game, and chase your personal best. After a round you see how your score compares with your best, so you always know if you beat yourself.

MAKE MOMO YOURS
Momo is your little blue companion. Pick a color, a face and a ring, and Momo shows up on your profile and in your games.

ALSO ON IPHONE AND IPAD
The watch is where Momo lives, but the same games are on your iPhone and iPad too, for when you want a bigger screen. Sudoku grows from 4x4 up to a full 9x9. Your level, scores and medals are shared across your watch, phone and iPad.

WHAT YOU GET
- Quick games made for Apple Watch
- Puzzle, reflex and head to head games, with a computer opponent that gets sharper as you win
- XP, levels, streaks and medals
- Your personal best shown after every round
- A customizable Momo
- Also on iPhone and iPad, with everything in sync
- No ads

Made by one person who wanted small, delightful games that are easy on the eyes and easy to put down. I hope Momo makes your day a little lighter.
en.releaseNotes: Improves performance of Ring, Lock, Pong and Stack on iOS 27 and watchOS 27.

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Sweep is here, a new game where you clear the board without hitting a bomb. The faster you clear it, the more you score.

- Game Center leaderboards are now live. See how you rank against friends and players around the world.
- Win celebrations in Trio, Drop Four, Boxes, Flip, Hop, Lights Out, Flood, Trail, Push and Sudoku.
- Hop now shows you which pieces must jump.
- Tap a game in your Best scores on the Profile tab to jump straight into it.
- Smoother animation on iOS 27.
- A fairer Puck opponent, harder Trail puzzles, and new medal goals in Peg Hop.
Improves performance of Ring, Lock, Pong and Stack on iOS 27 and watchOS 27.
